run_notify_success: run the script to send a success notification to Slack for community pipelines mirroring
run_notify_failure: run the script to send a failure notification to Slack for community pipelines mirroring
review_main: review the main function that sends Slack notifications based on pipeline mirroring status
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support additional notification channels beyond Slack
summarize_main: summarize the main function that posts success or failure messages to a Slack webhook
